title: PermissionError in path.resolve when uploading an attachment
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.0.8; operating system Debian 12; serer
region us-east-1.

## Steps

To reproduce:
- With the log window open, start uploading an attachment.
- Start the application as the service account.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

## Expected

Expected uploading an attachment to finnish without errors.

## Actual

Access is denied on a file the app itself created. The app
runs under a service account that is not the owner of the
data directory.

## Frequency

Reproduces on about half the runs.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/ui/upload.py:40 in on_drop
lattice/io/upload.py:118 in send
lattice/io/path.py:234 in resolve
PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: 'uploads/scan.pdf'
